A '''scuss''' was a creature found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] used its name&mdash;along with those of the [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]], [[hanadak]], and [[Munyip/Legends|munyip]]&mdash;in a game to help him find his way through the [[Arbo Maze]].
